mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPAREPART2 (SPP2_NO, SPP2_NAME, SPP2_CATEGORY, SPP2_EQUIPMENT, SPP2_UNIT, SPP2_MIN_STOCK, SPP2_REPLACE_CYCLE) VALUES (#{spp2_no}, #{spp2_name}, #{spp2_category}, #{spp2_equipment}, #{spp2_unit}, #{spp2_min_stock}, #{spp2_replace_cycle})
mapper.update: UPDATE SPAREPART2 SET SPP2_NAME = #{spp2_name}, SPP2_CATEGORY = #{spp2_category}, SPP2_EQUIPMENT = #{spp2_equipment}, SPP2_UNIT = #{spp2_unit}, SPP2_MIN_STOCK = #{spp2_min_stock}, SPP2_REPLACE_CYCLE = #{spp2_replace_cycle} WHERE SPP2_NO = #{spp2_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPAREHISTORY2 (SPP2_NO, SPH2_TYPE, SPH2_QTY, SPH2_EQUIPMENT, SPH2_WORKDESC, SPH2_USERNAME) VALUES (#{spp2_no}, #{sph2_type}, #{sph2_qty}, #{sph2_equipment}, #{sph2_workdesc}, #{sph2_username})
mapper.select: SELECT CORP_CODE AS corp_code, CORP_NAME AS corp_name FROM CORP WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CORP_GUBN = N'매입처' ORDER BY CORP_NAME
SELECT FAC_CODE AS fac_code, FAC_NAME AS fac_name FROM FACILITY WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY FAC_CODE
SELECT FAC_CODE FROM SPAREPART2_FACILITY WHERE SPP2_NO = #{spp2_no}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPAREPART2 (SPP2_NO, SPP2_NAME, SPP2_CATEGORY, SPP2_EQUIPMENT, SPP2_UNIT, SPP2_MIN_STOCK, SPP2_REPLACE_CYCLE, SPP2_VENDOR_CODE, SPP2_UNITPRICE, SPP2_AVG_PRICE) VALUES (#{spp2_no}, #{spp2_name}, #{spp2_category}, '', #{spp2_unit}, #{spp2_min_stock,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{spp2_replace_cycle,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{spp2_vendor_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{spp2_unitprice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE SPAREPART2 SET SPP2_NAME = #{spp2_name}, SPP2_CATEGORY = #{spp2_category}, SPP2_UNIT = #{spp2_unit}, SPP2_MIN_STOCK = #{spp2_min_stock,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SPP2_REPLACE_CYCLE = #{spp2_replace_cycle,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SPP2_VENDOR_CODE = #{spp2_vendor_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, SPP2_UNITPRICE = #{spp2_unitprice,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE SPP2_NO = #{spp2_no}
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(P.SPP2_AVG_PRICE,0) AS spp2_avg_price, ISNULL(( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SPH2_TYPE = 'OUT' THEN -SPH2_QTY ELSE SPH2_QTY END) FROM SPAREHISTORY2 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE SPP2_NO = P.SPP2_NO ), 0) AS current_stock FROM SPAREPART2 P WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE P.SPP2_NO = #{spp2_no}
mapper.update: UPDATE SPAREPART2 SET SPP2_AVG_PRICE = #{spp2_avg_price,jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE SPP2_NO = #{spp2_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPAREHISTORY2 (SPP2_NO, SPH2_TYPE, SPH2_QTY, SPH2_EQUIPMENT, SPH2_UNITPRICE, SPH2_FAC_CODE, SPH2_WORKDESC, SPH2_USERNAME) VALUES (#{spp2_no}, #{sph2_type}, #{sph2_qty,jdbcType=INTEGER}, '', #{sph2_unitprice,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{sph2_fac_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sph2_workdesc}, #{sph2_username})
